minutes_text:
MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  FEBRUARY 17, 2026

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 7:12 p.m. at City of Rolling Hills Estates Council Chamber,
  4045 Palos Verdes Drive N, Rolling Hills Estates, California, by VICE CHAIR POPE.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  VICE CHAIR POPE led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Pope, Ciarolla, Johnson, Holdsworth, Bain and
  McCormick

  Commissioners Absent:  Persichina

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  PRESENTATION

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION REORGANIZATION PRESENTATION
  (VERBAL RERPORT)

  THIS ITEM WAS POSTPONED TO A FUTURE MEETING BY A
  CONSENSUS OF THE COMMISSION.

  B.  SOUTH COAST BOTANIC GARDENS ACTIVITY UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Danielle Brown, Chief Impact Officer from South Coast Botanic Gardens, provided
  an update on their current activities and upcoming events.

  VICE CHAIR POPE commended Ms. Brown on a great presentation and all the
  wonderful things occurring at the gardens.

  5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF
  JANUARY 20, 2026

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
FEBRUARY 17, 2026
   COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH made a motion, seconded by
  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  JANUARY 20, 2026.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR POPE so ordered.

  6.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  NONE.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  2025 PENINSULA PARADE OF LIGHTS DEBRIEF

  Coordinator Morrow provided a debrief for the 2025 Peninsula Parade of Lights
  (as per the agenda material).

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK suggested an individual as a possible candidate
  for Grand Marshal for the 2026 event.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN commended Staff on another great parade.

  VICE CHAIR POPE asked that an event budget summary be provided for the
  Commission to review in future debrief reports.

  COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  BAIN to:

  RECEIVE AND FILE THIS REPORT.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR POPE so ordered.

  B.  2026 COMMUNITY SERVICES DEPARTMENT PROJECTS AND PROGRAMS
  OVERVIEW (VERBAL REPORT)

  Supervisor Pinuelas provided a presentation which included a brief overview of the
  2026 Community Services Department projects and programs. She provided
  information and details regarding department project and program timelines and a
  chart demonstrating the project and program timelines.

  Supervisor Pinuelas explained that the timeline chart and the items listed provide
  a snapshot of what department staff is working on at different times throughout the

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
FEBRUARY 17, 2026
   year rather than individual staff involvement on tasks and projects, in response to
  COMMISSIONER BAIN.

  In response to COMMISSIONER MCCORMICK, Supervisor Pinuelas stated that
  the Nature Center Project is projected to take 12-18 months to complete.

  VICE CHAIR POPE commended Staff for the presentation, stating that it clearly
  demonstrated the extent of Staff’s work on behalf of the City, and expressed her
  appreciation.

  8.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.
  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  COMMISSIONER JOHNSON asked whether there were any issues at Dapplegray
  Park due to the recent and forecasted rain. Superintendent Goldsmith responded
  that the primary concern is the arenas, which are closed prior to the rain for public
  safety. He added that once the rain has stopped, Maintenance Staff pump out any
  standing water prior to reopening the arenas to the public.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.

  10.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JANUARY 13, 2026

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JANUARY 27, 2026

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  HOLDSWORTH to:

  RECEIVE AND FILE.

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR POPE so ordered.

  10.  ADJOURNMENT

  VICE CHAIR POPE ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 7:40 PM TO THE NEXT
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON MARCH 17, 2026, AT 7:00

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
FEBRUARY 17, 2026
   P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD IN THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CITY HALL.

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  ___________________________  ___________________________
  Matt Morrow  Lisa Van Ingen Pope
  Community Services Coordinator  Vice Chair, Park & Activities
  Commission
